TABLE.NAME: qtype_omerohotspotmulti_options
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per omerohotspotmulti question - which OMERO slide it points at, and the hidden set of equally-acceptable correct-answer regions. A sibling of qtype_omerohotspot_options, not a mode of it: a click is correct against ANY one of several regions here, rather than one single shape. geometry is a JSON ARRAY of {type,x,y,rx,ry,rotation} objects - same per-shape shape local_omeroembed_hotspots.geometry already uses, on purpose, so the point-in-shape hit-test math ported into this plugin's own lib.php needs no translation, only a loop. Never read by anything outside this plugin's own grade_response()/edit form - the whole point of this table is that its geometry column never reaches a student's browser before they answer.

FIELD.NAME: subjectid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_omeroembed_subjects.id - which OMERO connection this question's slide is served through

FIELD.NAME: imageid
FIELD.COMMENT: OMERO image id - same convention as author.php's own 'images' param

FIELD.NAME: datasetid
FIELD.COMMENT: OMERO dataset id, if the student is meant to browse a dataset rather than one fixed image - same convention as author.php's own 'dataset' param

FIELD.NAME: geometry
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON ARRAY of {type,x,y,rx,ry,rotation} objects - plural sibling of local_omeroembed_hotspots.geometry
